source_snapshot.procedure: Collect amdxio XGMI linkstatus and run all-link four-point margining with BER 10, ErrCnt 5, phase 2:0.2 and DAC 4:0.4 ranges.
source_snapshot.criteria: CSV rows equal tested lanes (example 56x16=896); four ErrCnt fields <=5; four offset fields match parameters; six total/margin phase/voltage fields are nonzero.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL insecure SSH with tail-truncated evidence and fixed 896 assumption.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires live XGMI topology, compatible tool/schema, complete CSV, no concurrent GPU load and recovery.

old_problem: The example 56-link x16 formula is not bound to live GPU/socket/XGMI topology; tool/schema versions, field units, parameter authority, maintenance/no-load controls and recovery are missing. DeepSeek truncates both topology and results, assumes 896 rows and ignores the six independent nonzero fields.
disposition_reason: The executable amdxio method and source thresholds are sufficient to define the review-layer test. Tool/schema, live topology and expected cardinality are Project package inputs; 896 remains an example, never a universal constant. All four error, four commanded-offset and six nonzero usability fields are retained, with maintenance isolation, continuous fabric monitoring and no rerun.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2049, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2050 / Wistron-AMD SVM-01061-V003 / 786c3d72c88f1789 was directly read from XLSX.
The `-all` target is determined by the current XGMI linkstatus; expected CSV rows are the sum of approved live lane widths and only equal 896 when the signed topology proves 56 x16 links.
ErrCnt <=5 does not prove usable margin, so Total Phase/Volt and four directional margin fields must independently be nonzero while command-offset columns match exactly.
Full CSV and linkstatus are required; tail output cannot expose missing/duplicate lanes, schema drift or a zero margin field.
Margining all XGMI links requires an isolated maintenance window, no concurrent GPU work, thermal/power/fabric monitoring and one approved run without changed-parameter retry.
No amdxio command, XGMI margin sweep, GPU workload/state change, authentication or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Live-topology XGMI all-link four-point lane margin validation
test_case.purpose: Margin every approved live XGMI lane once using the exact four-point parameters and prove complete cardinality, <=5 directional error counts, exact commanded offsets, nonzero usable phase/voltage margins and preserved fabric health.
required_package: Exact row-2049 variant plus SUT/GPU/socket/XGMI/firmware/driver identity
Approved amdxio binary/version/checksum, XGMI margin capability and CSV schema/units
Signed live link/instance/endpoints/lane-width map and expected unique-row calculation
Approved BER=10, ErrCnt=5, phase 2:0.2 and DAC 4:0.4 semantics/tolerances
Maintenance/no-concurrent-load authorization, secure access, thermal/power/fabric aborts, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: PACKAGE-AND-MAINTENANCE-GATED; preserve GPU/XGMI/AER/APEI/CPER/system baselines and verify tool checksum/schema. Capture complete `amdxio -xgmi -linkstatus`, bind every approved link/instance/endpoints/lane width, calculate expected unique rows, and prove no concurrent GPU workload. After explicit one-run authorization, execute the exact `-all` BER/ErrCnt/four-point phase/DAC command once while monitoring GPU presence, link state, thermals and power. Retain complete raw output and CSV. Validate unique cardinality; Left/Right/Top/Bottom ErrCnt <=5; four offset fields match command; Total Phase, Total Volt and four directional margins are nonzero. Recheck full linkstatus/health. No clear, truncation or rerun.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved live XGMI lane has exactly one schema-valid row; all four directional ErrCnt values are <=5, all four offset fields match the commanded ranges, Total Phase/Volt and Left/Right/Top/Bottom margins are nonzero, and all GPUs/links remain present at accepted state without new critical errors or thermal/power anomaly.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tool/schema/topology/parameters, exact unique live-lane count, every per-lane error/offset/nonzero rule and clean post-fabric health. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate lane, malformed field, ErrCnt >5, offset mismatch, any zero required margin, link/GPU loss/downtrain, new critical error or abort. Missing package/map/authorization is NOT READY; 896 or summary-only output cannot independently PASS.
safety_gate: Approved isolated maintenance and zero concurrent GPU workload are mandatory for the all-link sweep.
Monitor GPU presence, XGMI state, thermals, power and errors; stop on loss/downtrain/escalation/anomaly or malformed CSV.
Preserve complete baseline/raw CSV; no log clearing, tail truncation or secret exposure.
One exact-parameter run only; no automatic rerun or parameter-changing retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, tool/driver/schema identity and checksum
Complete live XGMI topology/lane map and signed expected-row calculation
Maintenance/no-load proof, one-run authorization and pre-link/error/thermal/power baseline
Full raw margin output and immutable CSV with schema/hash
Per-lane cardinality, four ErrCnt, four offset and six nonzero-field analysis
Post-link/GPU/thermal/power/error health, no-clear/no-rerun audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On link/GPU loss, downtrain, health escalation, thermal/power abort or malformed CSV, stop the margin process and preserve first raw/link/error state. Quiesce the SUT and use only the pre-approved console/fabric recovery under new authorization; do not rerun margining or power/reset automatically. Revalidate all GPUs/links before service release.

source_conflict.reason: Live topology-derived cardinality, complete schema validation and all source fields replace the fixed 896 assumption, truncated evidence and absent maintenance/recovery rules.

blocked.reason: The command, criteria and recovery are complete; compatible tool/schema, live topology and maintenance controls are supplyable runtime Project inputs.
